explanation: This function is vulnerable to OS command injection (CWE-78) because path is concatenated directly into a shell command string executed by os.system(). An attacker supplying shell metacharacters in path could execute arbitrary OS commands on the host. The repair uses subprocess.run(["ls", "-l", "--", path], check=True) with shell=False and '--' end-of-options marker, eliminating both shell injection and option injection (the residual scanner flag reflects a generic subprocess rule).
